ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut at the link the record named. Gate spot-checked end to end: internal/proc/spawn.go:102-103 asserts the child spawned suspended (posixspawn.go: no instruction executes until releaseChild), :117-121 runs Cmd.Verify against the still-suspended pid, :124 releases only on success, and abortSpawn (:165-166) SIGKILLs the suspended child on failure. cmd.go:261 wires Serving.verifyProcess -> trust.VerifyProcess (serving.go:72-79), which reads the kernel-held CodeDirectory via task_name_for_pid + task_info TASK_AUDIT_TOKEN bound to pidversion (internal/trust/process.go:67-129) — a pid reuse denies as ErrPeerGone. The parent-self-verification the record cited is deleted from NewSpawnedClient (internal/wire/spawned.go:141-179), with authorizeSpawnedConn a documented directional-confinement waiver. Residual (ServingSameUser opt-out is a documented consumer posture, serving.go:33-38) noted for a consumer audit pass.
